description: This file defines the 'IfInstanceOf' class, which implements a conditional operation based on whether a specified object is an instance of a given class, within the mini-language processing of Apache OFBiz framework. It handles parsing, validation, execution logic, and artifact gathering for the <if-instance-of> XML element used in mini-language scripts.

classes.name: IfInstanceOf
classes.description: A class representing the <if-instance-of> operation, which conditionally executes nested operations based on whether a field's value is an instance of a specified class.

classes.name: IfInstanceOf.IfInstanceOfFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IfInstanceOf from XML elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the conditional check and runs appropriate sub-operations based on whether the field value is an instance of the specified class.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information from nested operations for analysis or documentation.
